An LLM agent that runs entirely on the device: no network calls, no server, no
data leaving the phone. It handles tool-calling and context management against
small open models running locally.

![Placeholder, replace with a real screenshot.](screenshot-01.png)

## Models

Evaluated and tuned Gemma, Qwen3, and Liquid AI's LFM on-device, comparing them
on three axes that matter once you leave the datacenter:

- **Latency**: time to first token and sustained throughput on Apple Silicon
- **Memory footprint**: what actually fits alongside a normal iOS app budget
- **Reasoning quality**: whether tool-calling stays reliable at these sizes

## Retrieval

The agent recalls personal notes and memories through an offline
retrieval-augmented pipeline over an Obsidian vault, using Apple's on-device
Foundation Models for embedding generation and semantic retrieval.

The no-network constraint shaped the design. Embeddings, index, and generation
all stay local, which rules out the usual hosted embedding APIs and vector
databases.
